[ 01 / ORIENTATION ]

Know the format. Read the label. Ask better questions. This is a cultural and product-information space—no prices, stock, checkout or orders.

[ 02 / THE FORMAT INDEX ]

Explore by form

Start with the format, then inspect what verified information should accompany it.

[ 03 / READ THE FACTS ]

The label is part of the experience.

01

Contents

Look for a clear ingredient list, declared allergens and the manufacturer or supplier.

02

Strength

Use only verified, product-specific potency and serving information supplied for that batch.

03

Traceability

Batch references, dates and supporting documents should be easy to find and understand.

04

Warnings

Required warnings belong with the product information, written plainly and visibly.

[ 04 / CULTURE DESK ]

More than a shelf.

Culture lives in artwork, language, music, clothing and the stories a neighbourhood tells about itself. This space can host commissioned local work and factual editorial pieces once the client approves them.
